rows.grounds: what is left over after prior distribution
one who has received an instruction or order
possessing a generous or elevated disposition
to other noble lords or masters

items.question: What obligation governs the sharing of remaining offerings with other noble lords?
premises: A noble-natured person acts under a received command.
A remainder persists after earlier acts of distribution.
Other noble lords remain as rightful recipients.
items.inference: The commanded noble-natured person must also distribute the remainder to the other noble lords.
uncertainties: The precise referent of śiṣṭa+īśvarebhyaḥ as specific lords or a general class is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Having received the command and being noble-natured, he also distributes what remains to the other noble lords.
